scope: NVIDIA FY2018-FY2024 original 10-K facts and three read-only objects from the completed inventory source Recorder; no source version was repaired or replayed.

gap_causes.original_facts: FY2018 original accession 0001045810-18-000010 has undimensioned USD Revenues and InventoryNet; FY2019 original accession 0001045810-19-000023 has undimensioned USD RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax and InventoryNet, each for its exact fiscal period.
gap_causes.native_recorder: Both issuer-years are in earliest_non_amended_candidates and annual_joint_candidates, but annual_pairs groups by exact revenue tag and therefore cannot connect them.
gap_causes.accounting_disclosure: FY2019 original 10-K Note 2 says the new revenue standard was adopted on 2018-01-29 using the modified retrospective method and comparative prior-period information was not adjusted. It describes the FY2019 consolidated impact as not significant; that statement does not establish an exact same-basis growth pair.
gap_causes.repair_boundary: Do not automatically bridge FY2018 to FY2019 by renaming the tag; keep this pair unknown unless a separately frozen original same-basis rule is justified.

gap_causes.native_recorder: The exact NVDA USD FY2022 revenue economic key appears in analysis/conflicts with earliest_value_alias_accession_or_form_conflict; FY2022 revenue is absent from earliest_non_amended_candidates and annual_joint_candidates while InventoryNet remains present.
gap_causes.code_cause: The frozen extraction rejects an earliest economic key whenever tag.nunique differs from one, even when accession, period, unit and numeric value agree.
gap_causes.repair_boundary: A new source version may deduplicate only exact same-accession, same-issuer, same-period, same-unit, same-normalized-value aliases under a predeclared total-revenue semantic rule; do not edit the frozen prior result.

gap_causes.original_facts: Own original 10-K has undimensioned USD Revenues and InventoryNet for FY2023. The native earliest and annual-joint ledgers contain those rows.
gap_causes.native_recorder: The frozen pair iterator has no admitted FY2022 annual-joint predecessor after the exact FY2022 alias conflict, so it cannot form the FY2023 pair. FY2024 forms a Revenues-to-Revenues pair with FY2023.
gap_causes.repair_boundary: Any FY2023 coverage recovery is conditional on a source-qualified FY2022 bridge and unchanged annual period/availability rules.

next_minimum_work: Freeze a new original-source alias and comparability rule: exact FY2022 dual-tag dedup plus an explicit FY2018/FY2019 accounting-break exclusion. Then validate original filing availability/version and historical N-PORT security identity before one information test.
